text: hep global GmbH is a privately held solar company based in Güglingen (Amtsgericht Stuttgart, HRB 737 065). It was founded by Christian Hamann and Thorsten Eitle, whose management announcement thanks 'our founders, Christian Hamann and Thorsten Eitle, as well as the other shareholders (Gesellschafter)'. The commercial register names hep global holding GmbH as its shareholder; the holding company was registered in 2022 with Thorsten Eitle and M. Hamann as managing directors.
short: hep global GmbH is a private Güglingen solar company founded by Christian Hamann and Thorsten Eitle; the register names hep global holding GmbH as shareholder.
